name: Paper Heron
bio: Archetype: Inspiration, Plant Impromptu. ⌽ [Impromptu Incantation] becomes Plant afflatus and deals Reality DMG. It can only attack a few times per turn; any excess inspiration will increase the power of those few hits. It'll automatically split against multiple enemies and deal more damage when there's only one enemy. ⌽ Upon entering battle, deploys an array that strengthens [Impromptu Incantation] attacks. This array levels up and becomes more powerful for each [Inspiration] unit in the team. Casting an Ultimate also level up the array (if not already at maximum level). ⌽ [Inspiration] is more likely to be distributed to Attack incantations. All allies recover [Eureka] at turn start and any active action will add [Inspiration] to [Impromptu Incantation] that turn. ⌽ Skills buff [Impromptu Incantation] damage.
